errors.evidence: The description fails to mention that the figure is composed of two separate charts, one for "Внос" (Import) and one for "Износ" (Export). It describes the data as if it were a single chart, which is a fundamental misrepresentation of the figure's structure and leads to numerous subsequent errors.

errors.text_span: започва от стойност около 10% през 2004 г.
errors.evidence: The description states that the "Общо" (Total) line starts at around 10%. However, in the 'Import' chart it starts at ~15% and in the 'Export' chart it starts at ~23%.

errors.text_span: Втората линия, представена с прекъсната сива линия и етикет „ЕС“
errors.evidence: The line for "ЕС" (EU) is a dotted line, not a dashed ("прекъсната") line. The dashed line corresponds to "Извън ЕС" (Outside EU).

errors.text_span: показва бърз растеж до около 65% през 2013 г., след което следва спад до около 50% през 2019 г.
errors.evidence: This description is completely incorrect for the "ЕС" (EU) line, which never goes above 30%. The values seem to be taken from the "Извън ЕС" (Outside EU) line in the 'Import' chart, but even then the peak is ~64% in 2011 (not 65% in 2013) and the end value is ~46% (not 50%).

errors.text_span: Третата линия, обозначена с прекъсната тъмносива линия и етикет „Извън ЕС“
errors.evidence: The description has already incorrectly assigned the dashed ("прекъсната") line style to the "ЕС" line. While the "Извън ЕС" line is indeed dashed, the description is now redundant and confusing. More importantly, the subsequent description of its values does not match the dramatic trend seen in the 'Import' chart.
The description of the "Извън ЕС" line is inaccurate. In the 'Import' chart, this line surges to nearly 60% by 2007, not 40%. In the 'Export' chart, it is around 45% in 2007.
